headline: Gold Prices Remain Unchanged in Pakistan Amid Flat International Markets
summary: Gold prices in Pakistan remained unchanged, with per tola staying at Rs429,136 and 10-gram gold at Rs367,914 in line with international trends.
why: Precious metal prices in local markets track global bullion benchmarks, serving as a hedge against inflation for retail and institutional investors.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Local prices directly track international gold spot prices.
